text: So sorry to bother you this late. I'm a childminder, have a boy aged 7 staying over, temp just now was 39.7. He's not himself at all, really sleepy and floppy, I had to shake his shoulder and say his name a few times before he'd open his eyes and even then he isn't answering me properly. He has dark skin so it was hard to see, but I've found little dark red/purple dots on his palms and soles and some inside his lower eyelids. I pressed a glass on the ones on his hands and they didn't go away. He does have a few itchy bug bites on his legs from the garden but these look different. I'm sorry if I'm overreacting, I just didn't know who else to ask.
